# 觀音經玄義記條箇

**ID:** X0641
**Volume:** X35
**Category:** 法華部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／法華部疏
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0641

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* anonymous *tiáogè* 條箇 (item-by-item topic outline) of the combined edition of [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s Zhīlǐ *Guānyīn xuányì jì* ([KR6d0047](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0047), T1727), preserved as X35n0641 in the *Xùzàngjīng*. The work is the topic-index complement to the *kēwén* 科文 sectional analysis of [KR6d0050](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0050), together with which it forms part of the late-Míng auxiliary apparatus on Zhīlǐ's *Xuányì jì*.

**Abstract**

The *Tiáogè* is a topic-by-topic index to the combined-edition *Xuányì jì*, complementing the structural-diagram approach of [KR6d0050](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0050). Where the *Kēwén* organises the text by hierarchical sectional division, the *Tiáogè* organises it by topical headings (*tiáo* 條, "items"; *gè* 箇, "individual"), allowing readers to locate specific doctrinal points without having to navigate the larger structural framework. The two together provide complementary navigational aids for the dense Sòng-period text.

The dating is securely fixed by the *Kèxù* preface to the late-1620s, with the printing project initiated by the lay-disciple [王季常](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%AD%A3%E5%B8%B8) Wáng Jìcháng in Chóngzhēn 1 (1628) and completed in Chóngzhēn 2 (1629). The auxiliary apparatus ([KR6d0050](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0050), [KR6d0051](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0051), [KR6d0053](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0053), [KR6d0054](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0054)) was probably completed in the same period or shortly thereafter.
